thread:
harper: Big thanks to @zara for running the umbrella station today
Someone left a soggy mountain in the lobby and Zara turned it into a drying festival :umbrella:
noah: Seriously, saved my blazer. also shoutout to Facilities for the industrial hairdryer move
(that was peak problem-solving) :clap:
zara: happy to help! set up a temporary rack and labeled the lost umbrellas. also put a sticky that says 'claim your soggy friend' :memo:
facilities: Glad it helped. We brought in extra racks and a small fan. No charge
Also moved two plants out of the drizzle zone so they don't drown :herb:
harper: planting a sticker on the kudos board for Zara and Facilities. People, react with :star: if you saw them in action today so we can include names on the note :star2:
stickerbot: Sticker created: "Dry-Day MVP" and awarded 1 sticker to zara. :sparkles:
noah: also kate from People Ops handed out emergency umbrella sleeves and some tea downstairs
Huge thanks to @people-ops for the quick comforting beverages :tea:
people-ops: Glad that helped. We'll send a small treat box and a handwritten note to Zara and Facilities. If anyone else wants to add a line to the card, DM me and we'll include it :mailbox_with_mail:
harper: mini-poll: next office kindness drive? react with :one: for "Warm Socks", :two: for "Travel-size umbrellas", :three: for "Hot tea stash"
zara: :three: hot tea please. and more plant rescue missions anytime :leafy_green:
reminder-bot: Reminder set: "Drying-rack check" tomorrow 09:00. (reminder created)
noah: love this. small things make the office feel like a team. thanks again everyone :heart:
